title: 第2097章 我只给你三秒的时间第2096章 格外的解气
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
第2097章我只给你三秒的时间
冷寂三个人带着几个手下敲开院子的大门时，门里的保姆警觉地打量着几个人。
还没开口，便被进来的人一支手枪顶到了脑门上。
保姆哪里见过这个场面，直接吓得大惊失色，嘴巴哆嗦着根本说不出话来。
“说，陈志康的情人在哪里？”
保姆哆嗦着手，指了指后面的客厅。
“里面几个人？”
保姆颤抖地伸出一根手指。
屠强立即推着她进了客厅，正在客厅里听着唱片机的女人看到这一幕，吓得差点尖叫起来。
可是屠强手里的手枪，让她把话硬生生咽了回去。
“你你你……你们干什么？”
冷寂脸色阴冷地走到沙发里坐下，狄子扬上前关掉了唱片机，打量了一眼客厅后也坐了下来。
几个手下则迅速地去搜查其他房间去了。
很快他们返了回来：“没人！”
确定这里是安全的，屠强看着保姆冷喝道：“赶紧去弄点吃的！要是敢耍花招，老子一枪毙了你！”
“是是是……”
保姆吓得浑身哆嗦，哪里有其他的想法？
而且其中一个手下跟着她去了厨房，她更不敢有其他的想法了。
冷寂看着有几分姿色的女人示意她坐下来。
女人战战兢兢地坐下，看着三个人道：“三位大哥……你们……你们想要干什么？我我我……我这里可什么也没有……”

刚才她已经看过电视上的新闻了，看到了这三个人的通缉令，此时看着三个人的样子，突然意识到正是通缉令上的三个人。
这么一想，更害怕了。
“我们也不为难你，把陈志康藏在这里的钱拿出来，我们拿了钱就走，不会给你添任何麻烦。不过你要是敢耍花招，那就别怪我们的子弹不长眼了。”
冷寂一番话吓得女人浑身发抖，她结结巴巴地道：“大哥……我我我……我不知道你在说什么……我这里真的没什么钱……”
“去你娘的！”
屠强一脚踹翻了女人身边的花盆，吓得她尖叫一声。
屠强恶狠狠地指着她：“你他娘的最好老实点儿！跟老子装傻是吧？我告诉你，我们来之前陈志康就已经告诉我们了，你是他的第六个小情人。而且他在你这里存了一大笔钱，现在你说你什么也不知道？”
女人赶紧缩着身体不知所措地看着他直摇头。
那么一大笔钱，够她下半辈子享受荣华富贵了，她要是交出来，那不是竹篮打水一场空吗？
冷寂冷冷笑了一声：“其实你不说也没关系。”他嘴上说着，手却拿出了一把手枪，开始一脸平静地上膛，听着咔哒声，女人看到他的枪口慢慢指向了自己。
“我只给你三秒的机会，如果不说，我们就自己找！我知道除了这个房子，路对面的院子也是陈志康买下来的。一！二！”
“我说！我说我说！！！”
女人听着冷寂连对面的房子也知道，吓得赶紧举手求饶。
content_en:
Chapter 2097 I only give you three seconds
When Leng Ji and his three men knocked on the door of the courtyard with a few of their men, the nanny inside looked at the people warily.
Before he could open his mouth, someone who came in put a pistol to his head.
The nanny had never seen this scene before. She was so frightened that her mouth was trembling and she couldn't speak at all.
"Tell me, where is Chen Zhikang's lover?"
The nanny trembled with her hands and pointed to the living room behind.
"How many people are inside?"
The nurse held out a trembling finger.
Tu Qiang immediately pushed her into the living room. The woman who was listening to the record player in the living room was so frightened that she almost screamed when she saw this scene.
But the pistol in Tu Qiang's hand made her swallow her words hard.
"You, you, you... what are you doing?"
Leng Ji walked to the sofa and sat down with a gloomy expression. Di Ziyang stepped forward and turned off the record player. After taking a look at the living room, he also sat down.
Several men quickly went to search other rooms.
Soon they came back: "No one!"
After making sure that this place was safe, Tu Qiang looked at the nanny and shouted coldly: "Hurry up and get some food! If you dare to play tricks, I will shoot you!"
"Yes, yes..."
The nanny was trembling with fear. Where could she have any other ideas?
And one of her men followed her to the kitchen, so she didn't dare to have other ideas.
Leng Ji looked at the pretty woman and motioned for her to sit down.
The woman sat down tremblingly, looked at the three people and said: "Three eldest brothers...you...what do you want to do? I, I, I...I have nothing here..."
She had just watched the news on TV and saw the wanted posters for these three people. Looking at the three people, she suddenly realized that they were the three people on the wanted posters.
Thinking about it this way, I became even more scared.
"We won't embarrass you. Take out the money that Chen Zhikang has hidden here. We will take the money and leave. We won't cause you any trouble. But if you dare to play tricks, don't blame our bullets for not having good eyesight."
Leng Ji's words scared the woman all over, and she stammered: "Brother...I, I, I...I don't know what you are talking about...I really don't have any money here..."
"Fuck you!"
Tu Qiang kicked over the flower pot next to the woman, causing her to scream.
Tu Qiang pointed at her fiercely: "You better be f*cking honest! Are you pretending to be stupid with me? Let me tell you, Chen Zhikang told us before we came here that you are his sixth little lover. And he deposited a large amount of money with you, and now you say you don't know anything?"
The woman quickly shrank back and looked at him at a loss, shaking her head.
Such a large sum of money would be enough for her to enjoy the glory and wealth for the rest of her life. If she handed it over, wouldn't it be a waste of money?
Leng Ji coldly sneered: "Actually, it doesn't matter if you don't say it." As he said this, he took out a pistol and began to load it with a calm face. Listening to the clicking sound, the woman saw the muzzle of his gun slowly pointing at her.
"I only give you three seconds of chance. If you don't tell us, we will find it ourselves! I know that in addition to this house, the yard across the road was also bought by Chen Zhikang. One! Two!"
"I said! I said I said!!!"
When the woman heard the silence, even the house opposite knew it, and she was so frightened that she quickly raised her hands to beg for mercy.
